g.text: Kept for your Take in: a copy with changes whose agent stopped
part-way, or when you pressed Stop or Stop everything.
Kept, nothing taken in: after an error or a restart (found again at the next
start), an away job's copy, a failed or clashing check with nobody watching.
At start, every copy that is not kept is cleared.
